caveats: ⚑ Drunken is modeled as a named resource pool (0→3, +1 per Burst-stage-1 entry by ANY ally, cleared to 0 by the Hangover block at the first Full-Burst end where it sits at 3). Trajectory is kit-derived (start 0 + stated gain + stated consume), not measured: stacks read 1 / 2 / 3 at rotations 1 / 2 / 3, then reset — a sawtooth, NOT a steady 3.

⚑ Hit Rate ▼20%/stack is authored as a NEGATIVE hitRatePct (−20 × stacks, so −60 at cap) fed live by the resource pool. hitRatePct→core-rate magnitude is engine-derived and measured-only; the SIGN and the per-stack kit value are literal, the resulting core-rate loss is not.

⚑ FIDELITY GAP: skill1's ally block is keyed to the same stage-1 entry that grants Drunken, so it goes live at the first Burst-1 cast and never lapses. The kit's real gate is 'only while in Drunken status', which goes DARK from the Hangover clear until the next Burst-1 entry (~one FB tail per 3 rotations). The engine has no buff-removal primitive other than removeOnReload, so this window is over-credited. perResource cannot express it either — the ally Crit Rate / caster-ATK values are FLAT (no '× stacks' in the text), so scaling them by the pool would be a different, larger error.

⚑ perResource recomputes each frame from the caster's live pool, so a 10s window that is still open when the Hangover clear fires will drop to 0 for its remainder (skill2's stage-3 buffs and the burst ATK grant). In-game these are almost certainly cast-time snapshots. Effect is confined to the ~1s tail past FB end on the reset rotation.

⚑ perResource on casterAtkPct (burst block 2) assumes the engine still routes the computed value through the caster-ATK flat conversion. UNVERIFIED against the code. If it does not, the buff silently becomes a raw number instead of a % of caster ATK.

Burst block is keyed burstCast (she is a fixed Burst II; her own burst block carries no separate activation clause), so it fires only on rotations she actually casts — NOT fullBurstEnter, which would over-credit in a multi-Burst-II comp.
Reload Speed ▲ is modeled, not skipped: it is a weapon-state modifier and gates shots fired for every ally.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Mast: Romantic Maid (mast-romantic-maid) is an MG/Water/Supporter/Burst II whose whole kit hangs off one self status, Drunken, gained +1 per Burst-stage-1 entry to a cap of 3 and wiped (with a 10s self stun, Hangover) at the first Full-Burst end where it is at cap. Drunken is therefore modeled as a resource pool rather than a stacked buff, because two consumers need the LIVE count (skill2's ×stacks Distributed Damage / Reload Speed, and the burst's ×stacks caster-ATK grant) and one needs the clear-down (the Hangover stun gate). Skill1 trades her own core-hit rate (Hit Rate ▼20%/stack, a real MG damage cost at coreAttackMultiplier 200) for a permanent team Crit Rate + caster-scaled ATK aura; those two aura values are FLAT in the text and are authored flat. Nothing in the kit is unmodeled; the known divergences are the Drunken-dark window after Hangover and the frame-live (rather than snapshot) behaviour of the perResource-scaled windows — both in caveats.

flags.estimate: −20 per Drunken stack → −20 / −40 / −60 as the pool fills; core-hit rate falls via the engine's hrCoreMult path.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #7: Hit-Rate→core magnitude is a derived engine relationship, measured-only. The per-stack PERCENTAGE and the sign are kit-literal, but how much core rate an MG actually loses at −60 Hit Rate is not in the kit text. This is her single largest self-damage term (coreAttackMultiplier 200), so it is not safe to treat as cosmetic.
flags.recipe: Harness test: run controlComp with her in the comp, capture damage events for her slot, and compare the core-bucket share across HRCORE=1 vs HRCORE=0 processes (module-const env — one process per setting). Then confirm against footage: count CORE HIT popups per magazine at 0 stacks vs 3 stacks in a recorded fight; the ratio pins the real slope.

flags.estimate: Sawtooth 1 → 2 → 3 → 0, clearing at the third rotation's Full-Burst end; time-average ≈ 2 stacks.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #4, but the kit states START (none at battle start), GAIN (+1 per Burst-1 entry), CAP (3) and CONSUME (all, at FB end when at cap), so the trajectory is DERIVED rather than guessed — the prior says derive when all three are stated. The assumption not stated in the kit is that exactly one Burst-1 entry occurs per rotation (true for the control comp's liter) and that the Hangover clear cannot be dodged.
flags.recipe: Harness test: onEvent, count stageEnter/fullBurstEnd and assert the buffApply value of the skill2 distributedDamagePct buff reads 15.03 / 30.06 / 45.09 on successive rotations, then 15.03 again after the clear. Cross-check in footage that the ▼Hit Rate stack icon shows 3 and vanishes at the FB end of the third rotation.

flags.estimate: 20.06% × stacks of her ATK → 20.06 / 40.12 / 60.18%; static fallback = 40.12% (2-stack time-average) if perResource does not survive the flat conversion.
flags.reasoning: perResource is documented as 'value IGNORED, computed each frame as resources × mult'. casterAtkPct is documented as FLAT-RESOLVED at apply time ((kit%/100) × caster.staticAtk). Whether the perResource path re-enters that conversion or emits the raw product is not determinable from the schema comments alone — and the two differ by orders of magnitude, so a silent failure here would be invisible in a ratio read.
flags.recipe: Harness test: filter buffApply for stat 'casterAtkPct' from her slot during her burst window and assert the emitted value ≈ (20.06 × stacks / 100) × her staticAtk (a flat ATK number, per the harness note), not ≈ 20.06 × stacks. If it emits the raw product, drop perResource and author the static 40.12%.

flags.field: override.skill1[2] (ally Crit Rate + caster-ATK aura continuity)
flags.estimate: Over-credits the team aura for roughly one Full-Burst tail per 3 rotations — the gap between the Hangover clear and the next Burst-1 entry.
flags.reasoning: The kit gates this aura on 'in Drunken status', which is FALSE from the clear until the next Burst-1 cast. The engine has no buff-removal primitive except removeOnReload, and the aura values are flat (no '× stacks'), so perResource would trade a timing error for a much larger magnitude error. Chose the timing error deliberately and am flagging rather than hiding it.
flags.recipe: Quantify before deciding it matters: A/B the same comp with the aura keyed to stageEnter:1 vs. hard-capped with durationSec set to the measured Burst-1→Hangover interval, and read the team-damage delta. If it exceeds ~1%, this needs an engine-side status-window primitive; log it as an engine-modeling gap rather than fudging the value.

flags.estimate: The 10s windows opened at stage-3 entry / burst cast lose their scaling for the ~1s tail after the Hangover clear on the reset rotation.
flags.reasoning: perResource re-reads the pool every frame, but a real 'x number of stacks' buff is almost certainly snapshotted at cast. The exposure is small because the clear lands at FB end and the window opened ~1s before FB start, but it is a systematic under-credit on exactly the highest-stack rotation.
flags.recipe: Harness test: capture the effective distributedDamagePct at FB-end+30 frames on the reset rotation; if it reads 0 rather than 45.09, replace perResource on the two 10s windows with a static value chosen per the derived stack count, or request a snapshot-at-apply flag for perResource.
